input.overview: Drained Bite-Sized is a one-turn speedrun through 15 vampires. A battle begins automatically and every switch drains the starting 25,000-point reserve. Shoot the gobble hole to slay the current vampire, add 10,000 points, and grow the Multiball; after vampire 15, surviving balls enter positive-scoring Victory Laps.
input.simpleOverview: Each vampire battle starts automatically. Shoot the gobble hole to slay the vampire and add another ball, but wait for the battle to begin if you want the full added-ball benefit. Slay all 15 before your points or balls run out.
input.summary: A vampire battle starts automatically with 25,000 points in reserve. Every switch removes points; shoot the gobble hole to slay the vampire, add 10,000 points, and advance. Slay all 15 to begin Victory Laps.

quickInfo.name: Starting reserve
quickInfo.summary: The game begins at 25,000 points and ordinary switch hits reduce that total during battles.

quickInfo.name: Gobble-hole slay
quickInfo.summary: The gobble hole defeats the current vampire, adds 10,000 points, and advances to the next battle.

quickInfo.name: Added balls
quickInfo.summary: Defeating vampires grows the balls in play; an introduction-period slay is faster but gives less ball growth.

quickInfo.name: Victory Laps
quickInfo.summary: After all 15 vampires, switches add points instead of subtracting them until every ball drains.

steps.text: Launch the first ball; the first vampire battle starts automatically and the 25,000-point reserve begins falling with switch hits.
Watch the timed coffin walls. When the path is open, shoot the center gobble hole to slay the current vampire and add 10,000 points.
Let the next battle begin before taking the gobble-hole kill when you want the full added-ball benefit; an introduction-period kill is faster but sacrifices some ball growth.
Repeat the gobble-hole slay through all 15 vampires while keeping at least one ball and some points in reserve.
Complete lit item sequences when the walls are awkward; enough successful item shots spot battle progress and can hold the gobble-hole path open.
Preserve the growing Multiball because losing every ball ends the run even if points remain.
After vampire 15, use the remaining balls for Victory Laps, when switch hits finally add positive points.

playfieldReferences.description: The center gobble hole behind the timed coffin walls.

playfieldReferences.label: Timed gobble-hole blockers
playfieldReferences.description: The rising and lowering walls that control access to the slay shot.

playfieldReferences.label: Battle-assist item shots
playfieldReferences.description: The lit sequences that can spot battle shots and keep the gobble-hole path open.

cautions.issue: Drained Bite-Sized requires the Drained module and uses one continuous turn.
cautions.response: Select the Bite-Sized app on a P3 fitted with Drained. The run ends when the score reaches zero, the game is tilted, or all balls in play are lost.

cautions.issue: The game supports high-score, low-score, and speedrun goals.
cautions.response: Prioritize completing all 15 vampires. Use the display when pursuing a specialized lowest-score or individual-battle record.
